$comment: Compliance registry — the single source of truth for whether a partner's terms have been reviewed and what restrictions apply. Every partner that has ever been reviewed (active, pending, or reviewed-but-not-applied) gets an entry here, even if nothing from that partner is live yet — this is a record of terms review, not a list of live partners. lib/partner-compliance.ts reads this file to gate every import (scripts/import-partner.mjs) and every render of partner data on the live site. Update this file whenever new terms are reviewed or a partner's status changes — nothing else needs to change for the gate to pick it up.

$materialization._read_this_before_editing_any_flag: A flag whose decision is MATERIALISED into stored data at write time CANNOT be changed by editing it here. Editing it looks like a policy change and is a silent no-op until the affected rows are re-synced. Categories below; scripts/check-compliance-materialization.ts enforces them on every build (package.json prebuild) and fails the build when this file and public.catalog_products disagree. Audited 2026-08-19, findings §19b/§21.

writeTime_requiresResync.imageUsagePermission: MATERIALISED. normalizeProduct (lib/partners.ts) swaps in IMAGE_PENDING_PLACEHOLDER when this does not allow real images, and the catalog sync writes the RESULT into catalog_products.image/images. lib/catalog.ts deliberately does not re-check. CHANGING THIS REQUIRES re-running that partner's catalog sync (e.g. scripts/sync-aaawave-catalog.ts) AND, when unlocking, downloading the images. Real instance: 2026-08-19, aaawave flipped to confirmed and 500 pages still rendered the placeholder until re-sync.
writeTime_requiresResync.status: MATERIALISED via checkImportGate/isPartnerLive, which filters ALL_WIRED_PARTNERS into PARTNERS at module load; rows were written from that filtered export. Setting a partner to active does NOT create rows (benign: nothing shows). MOVING A PARTNER AWAY FROM active does NOT remove existing rows — production keeps serving a partner whose terms review was withdrawn. That direction is the dangerous one and is a build-failing check.
writeTime_requiresResync.comparisonEngineConfirmed: MATERIALISED — same gate and same consequences as status.
writeTime_requiresResync.noPlagiarism: WRITE-TIME, import only. Consumed by scripts/import-partner.mjs when generating descriptions; descriptions are then baked into lib/<partner>-data.ts and catalog_products.description. Changing it affects FUTURE imports only and never rewrites text already imported.

readTime_takesEffectAtNextDeploy.excludedProducts: NOT materialised. requiresPerSkuFeatureCheck() is evaluated at read time inside lib/catalog.ts's getFeaturedDeals/getBestSellers, so a change takes effect on the next build with no re-sync. Pages are statically generated, so 'next deploy', not 'immediately'.

importTimeWarningsOnly.ftcDisclosureRequired: Prints a warning during import. Affects nothing already imported.
importTimeWarningsOnly.priceSyncSensitive: Prints a warning during import. Affects nothing already imported.
importTimeWarningsOnly.noMedicalClaims: Prints a warning during import. Affects nothing already imported.

$materialization.recordedFactsNoCodeReadsThem: commissionRate, commissionBasis, commissionTiers, commissionBase, cookieDays, cookieDaysConflict, paymentSchedule, excludedCategories, termsSource, googleShoppingAllowed, couponSharingRestricted, noBrandedPaidSearch, noUnauthorizedCoupons, noTrademarkBidding, noCouponSiteBehavior, noMarketplaceResale, noScrapingWithoutConsent, usAvailabilityOnly, paidSearchRequiresConsent, mustUseOfficialFeed, noBrandComparisonWording and every *Note field are RECORDS ONLY - several are declared in lib/partner-compliance.ts's type but no code branches on them. Editing them changes documentation, never behaviour. Do not assume any of them enforces anything.

brooklyn-delhi.imageUsageNote: No branding guidelines in partner terms; content use is encouraged. Proceeding with attribution based on terms language and risk assessment — written confirmation from Malika has not been received yet.

evdance.imageUsageNote: Checked directly via AWIN's advertiser terms page (ui.awin.com/merchant-profile-terms/67740) — every section (Branding, Publishers, PPC, Transactions, De-Duplication) is either unanswered or contains no image/content/branding usage language at all; Branding tab holds only generic program-overview marketing copy, not usage rules. This is genuine silence, not explicit permission — no restriction was found, but none was granted either. Proceeding assessed-low-risk on that basis, same treatment as Brooklyn Delhi. Revisit if EVDANCE ever publishes real terms.

golden-maple.imageUsageNote: Checked directly via AWIN's advertiser terms page (ui.awin.com/merchant-profile-terms/124092) — Branding tab explicitly states 'No branding guidelines'; no restriction on product-photo display anywhere else in the terms (General tab's substantive content is governing law/terms-modification/notification only, no mention of images; Publishers/PPC/Transactions/De-Duplication questionnaires unanswered). Genuine silence, not explicit permission — no restriction was found, but none was granted either. Same treatment as Brooklyn Delhi/EVDANCE/Canvas Vows/King Koil.

aaawave.termsSource: AWIN programme terms, advertiser 43143, last updated 13 Feb 2026 (archived outside this repo; deliberately not committed here so there is only one copy to drift)
aaawave.commissionBasis: net sales value, excluding tax, shipping and returns
aaawave.commissionTiers: custom tiers exist on some categories/products; the terms name 5% on HPE Networking as the example
aaawave.excludedCategories: none — the terms answer 'Are any products or product categories excluded from earning commission?' with No
aaawave.cookieDaysConflict: The programme terms (13 Feb 2026) state 90 days; the AWIN directory export states 120. UNRESOLVED, and deliberately recorded rather than averaged or silently picked: AWIN's own API does not expose cookie duration on either /programmes or /programmedetails (checked 2026-08-19 — programmedetails returns kpi.validationDays: 7, which is the commission validation period, NOT the cookie window). 90 is encoded because the merchant's own terms document is the more authoritative of the two available sources. 120 is deliberately NOT encoded anywhere. Resolve from the AWIN dashboard programme profile if it ever states it.
aaawave.comparisonEngineNote: Terms list Comparison engine, Comparison shopping service (CSS) and Shopping directory among allowed partner types, and 'Who Should Join?' names 'Tech bloggers & comparison sites' first.
aaawave.imageUsageNote: CONFIRMED 2026-08-19 from the programme terms themselves (AWIN programme terms, advertiser 43143, last updated 13 Feb 2026): the Program Perks section states "Exclusive assets (banners, data feeds, links) available through Awin's dashboard." Our product imagery arrives inside the data feed served to this account as a joined member, so it is covered by that grant. Supporting grounds: the Prohibited Practices list is enumerated and specific (Trademark Bidding, URL Spoofing, Coupon Abuse, Email Spam, Cookie Stuffing/forced redirects) and does not mention imagery - five itemised concerns omitting a sixth is stronger than general silence; and comparison engines, comparison shopping services and shopping directories are named allowed partner types, with 'Tech bloggers & comparison sites' named first under 'Who Should Join?'. Verified genuinely absent from the terms (confirmed with pdftotext, not a hand-rolled parser): image, photo, creative, logo, copyright, licen, intellectual property, permission, reproduce - so nothing in the document restricts product-photo display.
aaawave.imageUsageResidualRisk: ACCEPTED, operator ruling 2026-08-19. AAAwave's own Program Perks section states it is an 'Authorized dealer' for Arduino, HPE, ASUSTOR, Cooler Master and Avermedia - so much of the feed photography is likely manufacturer-owned, and this document does not establish sublicensable rights. Accepted because it reverts in a single edit to imageUsagePermission (set it back to 'pending' and every aaawave page returns to the placeholder on the next build; no data loss, the downloaded files simply stop being referenced).

dignity-lifts.noPlagiarismNote: Cannot copy product descriptions or website text verbatim — must be written independently or sourced only from the AWIN product feed

alorair-crawlspace.excludedProductsNote: Some SKUs excluded from commission — verify per-product before featuring in Best Sellers/Deals
alorair-crawlspace.noTrademarkBiddingNote: Affiliates prohibited from bidding on Alorair-branded keywords (e.g. "Alorair," "Alorair dehumidifier") on PPC platforms like Google/Bing Ads.
alorair-crawlspace.noUnauthorizedCouponsNote: Only coupon codes issued officially through Awin may be promoted — no expired, fake, or unauthorized codes.
alorair-crawlspace.imageUsageNote: Checked directly via AWIN's advertiser terms page (ui.awin.com/merchant-profile-terms/104549) — stronger than mere silence: the General tab explicitly lists 'Banner & Text Links: Access a variety of high-converting marketing materials, including banners, product images, and text links' as a program benefit. No restriction on product-photo display anywhere in the terms (Branding tab is company/product overview copy, not usage rules; Publishers/PPC questionnaires unanswered).

energy-muse.noMedicalClaimsNote: No claims about curing/treating ailments — keep descriptions factual only
energy-muse.priceSyncNote: Advertiser explicitly warns prices change often — sync feed frequently or omit price from static descriptions
energy-muse.comparisonEngineNote: Not explicitly confirmed in reviewed terms — verify before going live

advanced-clinicals.commissionRate: not disclosed until accepted, subject to change
advanced-clinicals.comparisonEngineNote: Not explicitly confirmed in reviewed terms — verify before going live

caire-beauty.noMarketplaceResaleNote: Terms prohibit reselling on marketplaces like Amazon/eBay — doesn't restrict GoPriceFinder's referral/comparison model.
caire-beauty.noBrandedPaidSearchNote: Affiliates cannot outbid Caire Beauty on branded keywords in paid search (Google/Bing/Yahoo).
caire-beauty.noScrapingWithoutConsentNote: Terms explicitly prohibit scraping the site/app for content (images, logos, text) without Caire Beauty's express written consent.
caire-beauty.imageUsageNote: Checked directly via AWIN's advertiser terms page (ui.awin.com/merchant-profile-terms/93563) — Branding tab explicitly states 'This advertiser is yet to define program terms under Branding.' General tab grants a non-exclusive, limited license to use Caire Beauty's logo/trademarks 'solely in the form and manner available from... the Platform' (AWIN-provided assets), but doesn't explicitly address product-photo display rights the way some other partners' terms do. Genuine silence on the Branding tab specifically — no restriction was found, but none was granted either. Same treatment as Brooklyn Delhi/EVDANCE/Golden Maple/King Koil/Canvas Vows.
caire-beauty.comparisonEngineNote: Publishers, PPC, Transactions, and De-Duplication tabs are all entirely unanswered on AWIN — no explicit confirmation or denial of comparison-shopping-service eligibility. Not explicitly confirmed in reviewed terms — verify before going live.

canvas-vows.noCouponSiteBehaviorNote: Coupon sites are not allowed in this affiliate program at all.
canvas-vows.imageUsageNote: Checked directly via AWIN's advertiser terms page (ui.awin.com/merchant-profile-terms/90193) — Branding tab explicitly states 'No branding guidelines'; no restriction on product-photo display anywhere else in the terms (Publishers/PPC questionnaires unanswered). Genuine silence, not explicit permission — no restriction was found, but none was granted either. Same treatment as Brooklyn Delhi/EVDANCE.

king-koil.noUnauthorizedCouponsNote: Only codes issued officially through Awin/King Koil may be promoted; commission can be zeroed out for unauthorized codes.
king-koil.paidSearchRequiresConsentNote: Terms state no paid search activity of any kind (search engines, ad networks, social) is allowed without King Koil's prior consent — stricter than the standard Awin questionnaire's per-item "Yes" answers suggest.
king-koil.mustUseOfficialFeedNote: Scraping the site for product data is explicitly prohibited — must use the provided product feed.
king-koil.imageUsageNote: Checked directly via AWIN's advertiser terms page (ui.awin.com/merchant-profile-terms/115216) — Branding tab explicitly states 'No branding guidelines.'; no restriction on product-photo display anywhere else in the terms (General tab's substantive content is coupon/PPC/feed rules only, no mention of images; Publishers questionnaire unanswered). Genuine silence, not explicit permission — no restriction was found, but none was granted either. Same treatment as Brooklyn Delhi/EVDANCE.

tsar-bomba.imageUsageNote: Checked directly via AWIN's advertiser terms page (ui.awin.com/merchant-profile-terms/109230) — a clear, intentional grant, not silence: the program overview explicitly lists 'High-Converting Creative Assets: Access to professional imagery showcasing our unique quick-release technology' as an affiliate benefit, and separately names 'SEO-Driven Marketers & Review Sites: For high-intent traffic looking for premium watch alternatives' as a target partner type — both verified verbatim. Strongest basis of any partner reviewed so far.

cosabella.commissionRate: 3% default, up to 25% via tiered bonus, plus a $35 stacking bonus per 15 confirmed sales
cosabella.imageUsageNote: Confirmed via Cosabella's own official Program Terms and Conditions PDF (Social Media Quick-Reference Guide, '4. Approved Imagery'): 'If you need brand assets, you may only use the official, authorized images provided directly within your publisher dashboard. Do not pull unapproved images from Google or third-party sites.' Verified verbatim in the formal, binding terms document — a direct written grant published by the partner, not our own risk assessment of ambiguous language (the separate marketing-overview PDF uses softer language: 'Wide range of banners, text links, product feeds, reels, and seasonal creative assets').
cosabella.noTrademarkBiddingNote: Terms state explicitly: 'We do NOT allow trademark bidding.' Direct linking is allowed, but not on trademark terms. Brand terms (e.g. "Cosabella") are also listed as an ineligible-for-commission paid-search keyword.
cosabella.noUnauthorizedCouponsNote: Only voucher codes listed as Active in Cosabella's 'My Offers' section on Awin are authorized; unauthorized, expired, fabricated, or third-party-sourced codes are strictly prohibited and can result in commission reversal.
cosabella.noBrandComparisonWordingNote: Terms explicitly restrict wording in marketing that compares Cosabella to other fashion brands ('Publishers are not allowed to use wording in their marketing that compares Cosabella to other fashion brands'). Assessed as not applicable to GoPriceFinder's current model, which compares the same product's price across retailers, not brand-vs-brand marketing copy. Flagged here for future reference in case site copy or marketing language ever shifts toward brand-vs-brand comparative claims.
cosabella.comparisonEngineNote: Comparison shopping service (CSS) and Comparison engine are both explicitly listed among Cosabella's allowed partner types in their AWIN program terms.
